title: Minccino 082/071 AR sv5K Wild Force Japanese Pokemon Art Rare Shibuzoh
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Minccino (Chillarmy) - Pokemon Wild Force (sv5K) - 082/071 AR - Japanese

You will receive the exact card pictured. These are photos of the actual card, not stock images. Front, back, and close-ups of all four corners are shown.

Card details:
- Name: Chillarmy / Minccino (Basic, Colorless)
- 70 HP
- Set: Wild Force (sv5K), Japanese
- Card number: 082/071
- Rarity: AR (Art Rare) - full-art alternate illustration
- Illustrator: Shibuzoh.
- Regulation mark: H
- Copyright: (c) 2024 Pokemon / Nintendo / Creatures / GAME FREAK
- Language: Japanese

Attacks (translated):
- Pound (Colorless) - 10 damage
- Clean Up (Colorless, Colorless) - Choose up to 2 Pokemon Tools attached to your opponent's Pokemon and discard them.

Weakness: Fighting x2. Resistance: none. Retreat cost: 1.

Flavor text (translated): It sweeps away dirt with its tail. Helpful when cleaning, though its fastidiousness can be a handful.

Note for collectors: this is an AR (Art Rare). Wild Force has 071 cards in the main set, so number 082 sits past the main set as a special-rarity pull. Art Rares use full-frame alternate artwork covering the entire card with a textured holo finish, and they are pulled far less often than the standard set cards.

Condition: Ungraded, in the condition shown. Please review all photos closely and judge for yourself - the images are of the actual card and are the most accurate description of its condition. Corner close-ups are included so you can assess edge and corner wear directly. Textured Art Rare foil shows handling marks more readily than standard cards, so please review the photos carefully.
